skills.name: Sun Shall Never Set on Me
skills.description: Perceives allies' chants and enemies' jeers as expectations towards himself. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +30% (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +30% (7 sec) *ATK Speed +180% (7 sec)

skills.name: Apollo Epicurius
skills.description: Summons a longbow of light, firing arrows of solid light. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Move Speed -40% (7 sec) *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -40% (7 sec) *ATK x 4400% Area Damage

abilities.name: Group: RoR III
abilities.description: RoR III Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy: Assassination
abilities.description: Has a set chance of making a Reaper appear, killing 1 enemy Ranger instantly when Rangers deploy.　  - Activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 3 seconds. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
